Japanese storybook illustration, simplified botanical shapes, thick soft dark-purple outlines, flat pastel colors, minimal internal details, layered plant heights, rounded organic silhouettes, cozy mobile game aesthetic. A single complete plant, front-facing with a slight three-quarter view, centered, full silhouette visible, generous transparent padding, designed to fit naturally inside a miniature garden diorama. Show exactly 3 clearly countable participant-linked major blossoms. Preserve the natural anatomy of cherry blossom. The participant-linked stems converge toward one shared floral crown.
